title: SQL优化案例库
description: 真实SQL优化案例，包含问题描述、分析过程和优化方案

cases.title: 全表扫描优化
cases.problem: 查询订单列表时出现全表扫描
cases.original_sql: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed' AND create_time >= '2024-01-01'
cases.problem_analysis: orders表有100万+数据，status和create_time列都没有索引，导致type=ALL全表扫描
cases.optimization_plan: 在status和create_time列上创建复合索引
cases.optimized_sql: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed' AND create_time >= '2024-01-01'
cases.index_suggestion: CREATE INDEX idx_orders_status_create_time ON orders(status, create_time)
cases.source: 美团技术团队SQL优化实践

cases.title: 覆盖索引优化
cases.problem: 查询用户列表时需要回表
cases.original_sql: SELECT id, name, email FROM users WHERE department = 'tech'
cases.problem_analysis: 只有idx_department索引，查询需要回表获取name和email字段
cases.optimization_plan: 创建覆盖索引包含所需字段
cases.optimized_sql: SELECT id, name, email FROM users WHERE department = 'tech'
cases.index_suggestion: CREATE INDEX idx_users_department_name_email ON users(department, name, email)

cases.title: 深分页优化
cases.problem: 深分页查询性能差
cases.original_sql: SELECT * FROM orders ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT 100000, 10
cases.problem_analysis: MySQL需要扫描100010行数据，然后丢弃前100000行
cases.optimization_plan: 使用游标分页替代LIMIT offset分页
cases.optimized_sql: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE create_time < '2024-01-01' ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT 10
cases.source: 字节跳动数据库最佳实践

cases.title: NOT IN优化
cases.problem: NOT IN子查询性能差
cases.original_sql: SELECT * FROM products WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT product_id FROM orders WHERE status = 'refunded')
cases.problem_analysis: NOT IN子查询会导致全表扫描，且如果子查询包含NULL结果不正确
cases.optimized_sql: SELECT p.* FROM products p WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.product_id = p.id AND o.status = 'refunded')
cases.index_suggestion: 在orders表的product_id和status列创建复合索引

cases.title: 隐式类型转换优化
cases.problem: 索引列使用字符串比较导致索引失效
cases.original_sql: SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = '12345'
cases.problem_analysis: id列是INT类型，但比较值是字符串，导致隐式类型转换，索引失效
cases.optimized_sql: SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = 12345

cases.title: 函数操作索引优化
cases.problem: 对索引列使用函数导致索引失效
cases.original_sql: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE YEAR(create_time) = 2024
cases.problem_analysis: YEAR()函数操作导致create_time索引失效
cases.optimization_plan: 将函数操作移到等号右边
cases.optimized_sql: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE create_time >= '2024-01-01' AND create_time < '2025-01-01'

cases.title: ORDER BY优化
cases.problem: ORDER BY导致Using filesort
cases.original_sql: SELECT * FROM users WHERE department = 'tech' ORDER BY create_time DESC
cases.problem_analysis: ORDER BY列没有索引，导致额外排序操作
cases.optimization_plan: 创建包含ORDER BY列的复合索引
cases.optimized_sql: SELECT * FROM users WHERE department = 'tech' ORDER BY create_time DESC
cases.index_suggestion: CREATE INDEX idx_users_department_create_time ON users(department, create_time DESC)
cases.source: 美团技术团队SQL优化实践

cases.title: GROUP BY优化
cases.problem: GROUP BY导致Using temporary
cases.original_sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) FROM orders GROUP BY status
cases.problem_analysis: GROUP BY列没有索引，导致创建临时表
cases.optimized_sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) FROM orders GROUP BY status
cases.source: 字节跳动数据库最佳实践

cases.title: JOIN优化
cases.problem: JOIN操作性能差
cases.original_sql: SELECT u.name, o.order_no FROM users u JOIN orders o ON u.id = o.user_id WHERE u.status = 1
cases.problem_analysis: orders表的user_id列没有索引，导致嵌套循环全表扫描
cases.optimized_sql: SELECT u.name, o.order_no FROM users u JOIN orders o ON u.id = o.user_id WHERE u.status = 1

cases.title: SELECT *优化
cases.problem: 使用SELECT *导致性能问题
cases.original_sql: SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = 1
cases.problem_analysis: SELECT *会查询所有字段，包括大字段，增加IO开销
cases.optimized_sql: SELECT id, name, email FROM users WHERE id = 1
cases.expected_improvement: 查询时间从10ms优化到2ms，减少数据传输量

cases.title: OR条件优化
cases.problem: OR条件导致索引失效
cases.original_sql: SELECT * FROM users WHERE name = 'test' OR age = 18
cases.problem_analysis: OR条件连接不同列时，MySQL无法有效使用索引
cases.optimized_sql: SELECT * FROM users WHERE name = 'test' UNION SELECT * FROM users WHERE age = 18
cases.source: 美团技术团队SQL优化实践

cases.title: LIKE通配符优化
cases.problem: LIKE前通配符导致索引失效
cases.original_sql: SELECT * FROM users WHERE name LIKE '%test'
cases.problem_analysis: LIKE '%xxx'模式无法使用索引
cases.optimization_plan: 使用全文索引或倒排索引
cases.optimized_sql: SELECT * FROM users WHERE MATCH(name) AGAINST('test')
cases.index_suggestion: ALTER TABLE users ADD FULLTEXT INDEX idx_users_name(name)

cases.title: IN列表优化
cases.problem: IN列表过长导致性能问题
cases.original_sql: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE user_id IN (1, 2, 3, ..., 10000)
cases.problem_analysis: IN列表超过1000个值时，优化器无法有效优化
cases.optimization_plan: 使用临时表或JOIN替代长IN列表
cases.optimized_sql: SELECT o.* FROM orders o JOIN temp_user_ids t ON o.user_id = t.user_id
cases.source: 字节跳动数据库最佳实践

cases.title: NULL值处理优化
cases.problem: IS NULL条件导致索引失效
cases.original_sql: SELECT * FROM users WHERE email IS NULL
cases.problem_analysis: 某些场景下IS NULL无法有效使用索引
cases.optimized_sql: SELECT * FROM users WHERE email = ''

cases.title: 派生表优化
cases.problem: 复杂派生表导致性能问题
cases.original_sql: SELECT * FROM (SELECT * FROM orders WHERE status = 1) AS t WHERE t.amount > 100
cases.problem_analysis: 派生表无法使用索引，导致全表扫描
cases.optimized_sql: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE status = 1 AND amount > 100

cases.title: 相关子查询优化
cases.problem: 相关子查询导致逐行执行
cases.original_sql: SELECT name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o WHERE o.user_id = u.id) as order_count FROM users u
cases.problem_analysis: 相关子查询对每个用户执行一次，效率低下
cases.optimized_sql: SELECT u.name, COUNT(o.id) as order_count FROM users u LEFT JOIN orders o ON u.id = o.user_id GROUP BY u.id
cases.source: 美团技术团队SQL优化实践

cases.title: ORDER BY RAND优化
cases.problem: ORDER BY RAND()性能极差
cases.original_sql: SELECT * FROM products ORDER BY RAND() LIMIT 10
cases.problem_analysis: RAND()需要为每行生成随机数，然后排序
cases.optimization_plan: 使用更高效的随机采样方法
cases.optimized_sql: SELECT * FROM products WHERE id >= FLOOR(RAND() * (SELECT MAX(id) FROM products)) LIMIT 10

cases.title: 数据类型转换优化
cases.problem: 字符串列与数字比较导致索引失效
cases.original_sql: SELECT * FROM users WHERE phone = 13800138000
cases.problem_analysis: phone列是VARCHAR类型，与数字比较导致隐式类型转换
cases.optimized_sql: SELECT * FROM users WHERE phone = '13800138000'
cases.source: 字节跳动数据库最佳实践

cases.title: 复合索引顺序优化
cases.problem: 复合索引顺序不合理导致索引失效
cases.original_sql: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE amount > 100 AND status = 'completed'
cases.problem_analysis: 索引为(amount, status)，但查询条件顺序不匹配
cases.optimization_plan: 调整索引顺序或查询条件
cases.optimized_sql: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed' AND amount > 100

cases.title: HAVING优化
cases.problem: HAVING子句过滤效率低
cases.original_sql: SELECT category, COUNT(*) FROM products GROUP BY category HAVING COUNT(*) > 100
cases.problem_analysis: HAVING在GROUP BY之后执行，无法利用索引
cases.optimized_sql: SELECT category, COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE stock > 0 GROUP BY category HAVING COUNT(*) > 100

cases.title: 复合索引最左前缀
cases.problem: 复合索引顺序不当导致索引失效
cases.original_sql: SELECT * FROM users WHERE age > 18 AND name = 'test'
cases.problem_analysis: 索引为(name, age)，但查询先使用范围条件age，导致name索引无法使用
cases.optimization_plan: 调整查询条件顺序或重建索引
cases.optimized_sql: SELECT * FROM users WHERE name = 'test' AND age > 18
cases.index_suggestion: 确保等值条件列在复合索引前面
cases.source: 美团技术团队SQL优化实践

cases.title: 范围查询阻断
cases.problem: 范围查询后索引失效
cases.original_sql: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE create_time > '2024-01-01' AND status = 'completed'
cases.problem_analysis: create_time是范围条件，导致后面的status无法使用索引
cases.optimized_sql: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed' AND create_time > '2024-01-01'
cases.source: 字节跳动数据库最佳实践

cases.title: 不等于操作优化
cases.problem: NOT EQUAL导致全表扫描
cases.original_sql: SELECT * FROM users WHERE name <> 'admin'
cases.problem_analysis: <>操作无法使用索引，导致全表扫描
cases.optimized_sql: SELECT * FROM users WHERE name < 'admin' UNION SELECT * FROM users WHERE name > 'admin'

cases.title: 隐式JOIN优化
cases.problem: 隐式JOIN语法性能差
cases.original_sql: SELECT * FROM t1, t2, t3 WHERE t1.id = t2.t1_id AND t2.id = t3.t2_id
cases.problem_analysis: 逗号分隔的隐式JOIN语法可读性差，优化器可能无法正确优化
cases.optimized_sql: SELECT * FROM t1 JOIN t2 ON t1.id = t2.t1_id JOIN t3 ON t2.id = t3.t2_id

cases.title: 多层LEFT JOIN优化
cases.problem: 多层LEFT JOIN导致性能问题
cases.original_sql: SELECT * FROM a LEFT JOIN b ON a.id = b.a_id LEFT JOIN c ON b.id = c.b_id LEFT JOIN d ON c.id = d.c_id
cases.problem_analysis: 多层LEFT JOIN会产生笛卡尔积，数据量指数增长
cases.optimization_plan: 减少JOIN层数或使用子查询
cases.optimized_sql: SELECT * FROM a LEFT JOIN (SELECT b.*, c.*, d.* FROM b LEFT JOIN c ON b.id = c.b_id LEFT JOIN d ON c.id = d.c_id) AS t ON a.id = t.a_id
cases.source: 美团技术团队SQL优化实践
